theorem.name: PGL3PrymDimensionMatchingTheorem
theorem.statement: The remaining q79 spectral gerbe equation is a square complex system: its trace-free obstruction tangent is eight-dimensional and Serre-dual to the eight-dimensional infinitesimal PGL3 alignment space. This types an 8x8 Jacobian test but does not assert its determinant or a zero.
